fieldGuide.usage: Completed opportunities, not a future projection. WR/TE: receiving. RB: rushing + receiving. QB: passing + rushing; standard four-point passing TD scoring.
fieldGuide.footballScore: Saved football-only research score within position, not projected points or market value. No weights changed for publication.
fieldGuide.dynasty: Saved age-aware profile preview, not a validated remaining-career valuation. Age screens still apply to dynasty gap research.
fieldGuide.confidence: Sample and role evidence strength, not the chance a player will break out.
fieldGuide.schedule: Saved upcoming opponents and average fantasy points allowed to this position through the cutoff. Higher allowance means more generous past matchups, not guaranteed future points.
fieldGuide.injury: Current reserve/report overlay is dated separately from completed-week scoring. Reported unavailable players are excluded from the immediate gap screen, but remain in All players. IR is not automatically season-ending; no return date or injury probability is invented. Missing reports do not prove health.
fieldGuide.routes: No verified, current all-routes-run source with public reuse permission was found among the checked feeds. Open targeted-pass separation/cushion/YAC metrics are included separately; they are not routes run or targets per route.
fieldGuide.market: Dated DynastyProcess/FantasyPros ECR references, GPL-3.0. Dynasty values are relative trade-value proxies, not dollars or actual completed trades. Redraft ECR is not ADP. Only redraft has a matched-pool, short-horizon rank comparison; no validated dynasty fair-value gap.

historical.unit: Repeated player/cutoff observations, not unique players or independent trials

availabilityContext.note: Retrieval time is not a new practice report. Missing reports do not confirm health.

publicStudy.selectionRule: Fixed families, Ridge alpha20. Select by 2024 error; require >=1% reduction and a reduction in 2025; otherwise retain current PPG. No weight optimization on 2025.
publicStudy.historicalLimit: 2024 and 2025 were already inspected in previous research. These are chronological retrospective evaluations, not a new untouched holdout. Four cutoffs repeat players and overlapping outcomes; counts are not independent trials.

definitions.partial: Sensitivity excludes same-week injury-report games below40% snaps and less than half a prior established60%+ role (at least2 prior snap games). Not a confirmed in-game injury diagnosis. Other limited-role games remain.
definitions.shrink: raw gap × appearances/(appearances+4). Descriptive conservative screen, not a breakout probability.
definitions.qb: CPOE is how many more/fewer passes were completed than expected per100 attempts. Team cutoff-only CPOE is shrunk using attempts/(attempts+100). QB scenario shifts receiving usage only, capped at±2 PPR/game, then tested as a candidate.
definitions.gameScript: Candidate discounts usage by half the fraction of recorded opportunities in Q4 with a pre-play margin of21+. Not a claim all blowout work is worthless.
definitions.prior: Blend current PPG with own previous-season PPG, weighting the prior by at most8 appearances. No prior history means no invented prior.
definitions.gapParts: TD, catch, yard and residual point gaps sum to usage minus actual. These are scoring sources, not a causal luck-versus-skill verdict.

forecastWindow.outcome: PPR per recorded appearance over the next four regular-season week numbers, bounded by Week18; not an availability or dynasty-career forecast

marketBenchmark.method: Market-only quadratic rank-score regression trained on2021–2024; evaluated on the same dated-market matched 2025 observations as Outlook. Latest PPR rank date<=cutoff week's last regular-season game; maximum14-day source lag. No current dynasty/ADP feed is used in historical rows.
marketBenchmark.limits: Rank gaps use all eligible matched players, including those with no later appearance; scoring errors and mean excess can only grade recorded appearances. The >=8-place subgroup is descriptive and noisy and does not establish an injury-adjusted strategy or include trade/waiver costs. Repeated overlapping observations are not independent trials. Market rank is not an executed price. The 2025 screen-enablement check is a research guard, not untouched validation. Football-only Outlook stays independent of price.

marketSource.limitations: Expert-consensus proxy, not real completed trades or ADP. Data dates may lag observation. Dynasty prices cover multiple seasons; four-week production ranks are a different horizon.
marketSource.adpStatus: FFC PPR/12-team ADP included where uniquely matched, with the original draft dates. This is draft price, not a live trade quote.

roleStudy.definition: Baseline3 appearances vs last2, same team, >=5 recorded appearances. Both recent games must exceed baseline on >=2 measures: snaps+15pp, target share+5pp (RB backfield share+15pp), carries+targets for RB or targets for WR/TE >=1.5x and +2/game. Injury-report low-snap samples and stale weeks require review, not a role alert.
roleStudy.laggingDefinition: Rising role plus recent usage minus PPG>=2, recent PPG<=baseline+2 and <15 RB/WR or <12 TE. Fixed research screen, not breakout probability.
roleStudy.comparisonDefinition: Same position, earlier seasons only, nearest saved cutoff (5/8/11), age within4 years, recorded sample within1 appearance, grouped distance<=1.5. At most30 different identities, >=15 selected AND graded required. Same player excluded. Fixed meaningful scales; five equal groups: age/experience, draft, scoring, workload, change. Missing draft facts are unknown, not undrafted.
roleStudy.limitations: 2024/2025 already inspected in project research. Repeated cutoffs and players are not independent. Historical source revisions possible. Similarity is descriptive, not causation or a calibrated personal probability. No appearance is reported separately, not zero PPG. The saved Outlook method was chosen using2024 and checked2025; 2024 Outlook is not an independent benchmark. No ranking/forecast weights changed.

weeklyPlayerContext.method: Last completed team game at the player's cutoff versus his previous three recorded appearances on the same team. Injuries/depth are separately dated current context; no return dates or causal effect are inferred.

scheduleStudy.verdict: Context only: no production forecast weights changed.
scheduleStudy.limitations: Retrospective, not untouched. Active appearances only; no later appearances excluded, not zero. Raw defense allowances are not opponent-adjusted. Team-season bootstrap blocks cannot remove all dependence. Secondary yards metrics exploratory, not a selected replacement.

gameHealthStudy.name: Verified early-exit sensitivity
gameHealthStudy.decision: Context only; not promoted to forecasts. The manual archive is incomplete and affected samples are too small for a reliable deployment claim.
gameHealthStudy.method: Same earlier-year-trained model and unchanged raw features/outcomes; add source-confirmed exits below 40% snaps to existing partial-game sensitivity inputs. Unreviewed baseline flags are retained. No threshold or weight search.
gameHealthStudy.limitations: 2024/2025 were previously inspected. Repeated player windows overlap. Source reports were collected retrospectively, dates are conservative date-level availability, and revised raw data is not a historical data vintage. This is a limited sensitivity experiment, not an untouched holdout or league-wide proof.
gameHealthStudy.sourceScope: All listed offensive skill-position interruptions from four selected NFL roundups, plus the separately documented 2024 Puka opener. Incomplete discovery sample, not a league-wide injury archive.

checks: Actual PPR and recorded-game counts against raw NFL weeks
Red-zone/deep/snap/TD facts recomputed from cutoff-limited sources
Market ranks and scores within source bounds
Role cutoff and earlier-season comparison/count checks
Recent-game scoring, usage and work against raw weekly sources; dated injury openings
dataAudit.limitation: Passing checks verifies internal consistency with these sources, not perfect source truth, future accuracy or complete coverage.

valueEvidenceStudy.forecastPolicy: Diagnostic only; production forecast weights are unchanged.
valueEvidenceStudy.limitations: Retrospective examined seasons, not untouched or causal. Matched controls can repeat and share teams. Active-game PPR excludes missed games, reported separately. Historical prices are redraft expert ranks, not dynasty trade prices or realized profit. Missing age/market weakens matching and is counted. No manager acceptance prediction.

valueEvidencePolicy.dynastyStatus: Market lens plus age/draft/role context; not a trained career-value forecast.
valueEvidencePolicy.historyStatus: Diagnostic only: no position passed the fixed two-year promotion rule.
valueEvidencePolicy.privacy: Only professional-player evidence and aggregate research; league manager/trade data excluded.

valueTrackRecord.note: Same-provider/lens/common-pool standing changes, not profit. Original calls and official forecasts remain immutable.

injuryRefresh.note: Current health/QB/teammate overlay only. Source report weeks and failed-source dates remain explicit.
